summary: A second Baidu source, baidu_web: Baidu AI Search (POST /v2/ai_search/web_search) restricted to xueshu.baidu.com, because the Baidu Scholar tool answers 404 for the owner's account. It shares the Qianfan key of Baidu Scholar (SourceInfo.key_shared_with; one key file, one field in Settings) and has its own switch, daily counter (cap 40), 24 h cache and status. Wired into the daily feed (Chinese projects with Chinese keywords), project-creation candidates and typed seed titles; papers both Baidu sources find are deduplicated by key and title; a Baidu Scholar failure never stops the web search. The parser is built on a trimmed real answer. Also records the Wanfang evaluation (paid, 10-day trial: considered, not adopted; no adapter).
scope_note: Worktree baidu-web on main 582ce17. Critical: a new outbound request and provider adapter, a shared secret, new settings. Data sharing is the same as the already-approved Baidu Scholar source (owner approvals quoted in ADR 0039 and its 2026-10-23 addendum; owner_approved stays false). No migration, no model call, no network call in any test; no real database or key touched.

budget_impact.rationale: No model call or token. At most one extra Baidu request per Chinese keyword/query when the web switch is on and the shared key is saved (up to 3 per project refresh, one per creation phrase, one per typed seed search), counted in its own local cap of 40 a day and answered from a 24 h cache when repeated. Baidu's own allowance is 1500 free calls a month; billing after that is unverified (owner to-do).
budget_impact.before: only Baidu Scholar (404 for the owner's account) could add Chinese papers
budget_impact.after: same model cost (zero); one extra Baidu request per Chinese search when the web switch is on

open_risks: The error response shape of the Baidu AI Search, the meaning of its `date` field, billing after the 1500 free calls a month and whether the site filter becomes a paid feature are UNVERIFIED (owner to-do: keep billing off or confirm in the Qianfan console).

Only one real answer (7 references for one query, 2026-10-23) was available: how often content lacks an abstract or keywords, and how many papers a query returns, is unmeasured. The two Baidu sources may use different ids for the same paper, so the same paper can occasionally be stored twice on different days.
The settings row was tested with Node virtual pages only, not in a browser; no real key was used by this change, so tools/source_smoke.py baidu_web has not been run against Baidu.
Independent review not done by the implementing agent (critical class: needed before release).
